name: reactorvault
description: Non-custodial on-chain risk guardian. The owner sets boundaries (drawdown floor, concentration cap, stale-feed pause); a reactive contract watches price feeds around the clock and an executor enforces the rules on-chain. Contracts and events are the whole interface - no UI dependency, machine-native by construction.

howToUse.contracts: Every deployed family member with chain, address, generation and role. Verify with eth_getCode before use - never trust an address without asking the chain.
howToUse.events: Push channel: subscribe to topic0 on the contract's chain and you learn about alarms and actions before any human dashboard renders them. All state is public on-chain, no auth, no API keys.
howToUse.generations: w2.2 is the live testnet stand (the chassis economy pilot); w3 is the pay-on-delivery family (deploy pending); main is the Robinhood risk guardian (planned).

generations.w2.2: The live testnet stand (deployed 19.11). Superseded by the w3 pay-on-delivery family at the next redeploy; keeps running as the chassis economy stand.
generations.w3: Pay-on-delivery family (ADR-GAS): accrued fees, fee cap = auto-refuse, two-sided fund, per-action billing. Deploy rehearsed dry; live deploy pending.
generations.main: The Robinhood Chain guardian: Reactive 1597 brain + Robinhood 4663 executor and stock-token safes. Planned 28-30.11.

contracts.name: RulesEngine
contracts.description: Event rules to callbacks: subscriptions, cooldowns, idempotency. The only sender the executor accepts.

contracts.name: GasPayer
contracts.description: Superseded by pay-on-delivery (ADR-GAS). Silent by construction; no client funds ever passed through it.

contracts.name: ReliefFund
contracts.description: Fuel depot: ward registry, real-number feeding, horizon alerts, debt revival.

contracts.name: Watchdog
contracts.description: Cron patrol and cry relay, zero idle cost.

contracts.name: FuelConverter
contracts.description: Listens to the depot horizon, places fuel purchase orders.

contracts.name: AssetVault
contracts.description: ETH safe: free entry, accrued fees, fee cap = auto-refuse, invariant accounting. Withdraw always works, in any system state.

contracts.name: Executor
contracts.description: Callback receiver: rebalance + billing. v3 adds per-action billing and margin sweep; deploy pending.

contracts.name: GasVault
contracts.description: Two-sided treasury: earned/spent counters, buyer pulls limited to earned, invariant treasury = balance.

contracts.name: FuelBuyer
contracts.description: Pulls purchase funds from the fund itself, buys fuel, delivers it to the depot.

contracts.name: OneToOneOracle
contracts.description: Fixed 1:1 rate source for the demo market.

contracts.name: AavePoolAdapter
contracts.description: Aave v3 WETH pool plugin (IPoolAdapter); capital transits through the safe.

contracts.name: MorphoPoolAdapter
contracts.description: Morpho market plugin (IPoolAdapter); capital transits through the safe.

events.name: LowGas(uint256,uint256)
events.meaning: The brain's reactive-gas reserve fell below target: recalibrate tariffs (there is no refill circuit).

events.name: ExecutorLowEth(uint256,uint256)
events.meaning: The executor's ETH tank is below threshold: callback delivery at risk.

events.name: HorizonAlert(uint256,uint256,uint256,uint8)
events.meaning: Fuel horizon warning: days of feeding left at the current burn rate.

events.name: LowFund(uint256,uint256)
events.meaning: Depot reserve below floor.

events.name: RuleSet(bytes32,uint256,uint256,bool,uint64)
events.meaning: A rule was configured: (chain, topic0, active, cooldown).

events.name: RuleFired(uint256,uint256,uint256)
events.meaning: The brain reacted to an origin event and dispatched a callback.

events.name: Subscribed(uint256,address,uint256)
events.meaning: A new subscription is live: (chainId, origin emitter, topic0).

events.name: Rebalanced(address,uint256,uint256)
events.meaning: Capital moved between pools: (sender, origin block, amount).

events.name: MarginSwept(uint256)
events.meaning: Margin above the tank target was swept into the fund.

events.name: VaultUnpaid(address)
events.meaning: A serviced safe could not be billed (fee cap reached).

events.name: FeeAccrued(uint256)
events.meaning: Service fee accrued on a safe (accounting debt, settled at cash events).

events.name: FeesCollected(address,uint256)
events.meaning: Accrued fees were settled and sent.

events.name: VaultDeposit(address,address,uint256,uint256)
events.meaning: A deposit into the safe: (sender, owner, assets, shares).

events.name: VaultRedeem(address,address,address,uint256,uint256)
events.meaning: A redeem from the safe: (sender, receiver, owner, assets, shares).

events.name: Deposited(address,uint256,uint256)
events.meaning: Native cash into the system (part may go to the treasury).

events.name: Withdrawn(address,uint256)
events.meaning: Cash out of the system: the owner exit that always works.

events.name: WatchdogAlert(uint256,uint256,bool)
events.meaning: Patrol missed a pulse (or recovery detected).

events.name: Revived(address,uint256,uint256)
events.meaning: SYSTEM debt was covered and delivery resumed: (target, debt, topUp).

events.name: FuelOrdered(uint256,uint8)
events.meaning: The auto-crane placed a fuel purchase order.

events.name: FuelBought(uint256,address)
events.meaning: Fuel bought: ethSpent credited against the fund.

events.name: PurchasePulled(address,uint256)
events.meaning: The buyer pulled purchase funds from the fund (bounded by earned).

evidence.note: Full-cycle transaction hashes (origin event -> react -> callback) are added here at submission. Until then the live stand is monitored by the sensor; counters are readable on-chain (see events above).
